nearest_store: No Kroger store in the Birmingham metro; nearest stores Hartselle and Decatur, about 75 miles. Kroger Delivery has served Birmingham since 2022 from a spoke at 30 W Oxmoor Rd fed by the Atlanta (Forest Park) fulfillment center; not on the 2025 to 2026 closure lists, but late 2026 status and SNAP acceptance on that service not confirmed
Little Rock, several Kroger stores in the city (Cantrell Marketplace, Colony West, The Heights), under 10 miles
Atlanta, about 15 Kroger stores in the city, under 10 miles

No Kroger-branded store in the Chicago metro (Kroger runs Mariano's there, which does not count); nearest Kroger is Bourbonnais, about 55 miles. Kroger Delivery from the Pleasant Prairie WI fulfillment center ended when it closed on 1 Feb 2026
Indianapolis, multiple Kroger stores in the city (for example 10th and Shortridge), under 10 miles
Louisville, multiple Kroger stores in the city, under 10 miles
Dearborn (Eastborn and Westborn) and Ferndale (8 Mile Rd) Kroger stores, about 9 to 10 miles; Romulus fulfillment center remains open
No Kroger-branded store in the St. Louis area (Kroger left in 1986; Ruler Foods there is a separate banner); nearest Kroger stores are Troy MO and Nashville IL, about 50 to 55 miles
Jackson, Kroger at 4910 I-55 N, about 4 miles; also Clinton, Ridgeland and Brandon
Columbus, many Kroger stores in the city, under 10 miles
Columbia, Kroger Forest Acres (3403 Forest Dr), about 4 miles; also Two Notch Rd and Killian's Crossing
Nashville, multiple Kroger stores in the city, under 10 miles
Houston, many Kroger stores in the city (for example El Dorado, Cypresswood), under 15 miles
Richmond, 7 Kroger stores in the city (for example Carytown, 3507 W Cary St), about 2 miles
Charleston and South Charleston Kroger stores (Kanawha City; 5 River Walk Mall), under 5 miles
